statement: For the actual relative closed-disk loop and one-dimensional proper interior operator group of C76, the filled closed subset enlarges to every strip with abelian effective base image or endpoint-character vector image of dimension at most one. The construction prescribes r times each original finite-endpoint displacement, retains every operator component, and controls maps and inverses uniformly at arbitrary strip and original-circle accumulations. Compact convex averages in an explicit Hilbert embedding give a continuous increasing base deformation; the scalar-character/base C62 triangle realizes it in one compact actual three-word family. A second compact-product selection uses a proved simultaneous compact local pair-transport property for all exact path-group actions. The remaining excluded strips are precisely bounded nonabelian-base strips with two independent finite-endpoint characters. The actual restriction morphism is retained; no filling through an excluded strip is inferred.
depends_on: C75 actual strip and character decomposition; C76-C77 compact source families, character images, exact transitive comparison actions and original-boundary estimates; C62 proper-real-fiber triangle and inverse bracketing; C63 relative interlaced convex approximation; C64 open path-group orbit maps and proved compact-covering lemma. The positive-average Hilbert space, local pair transports and two-stage selection are proved explicitly here.
manuscript_passages: Section 23, folios 140-141, scans 279-281; Part C(b), exact rank-one endpoint-image filling and remaining two-character bounded-strip obstruction.
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The compact convex average space is constructed explicitly from dense continuous test functions in ell-squared, with compactness and averaging verified directly. The comparison-plane triangle checks proper fibers, increasing target maps and actual source labels. Compact path lifting is used only through the proved compact-covering lemma and open orbit map; no section or unstated fibration is assumed.
computational_checks: This is a qualitative compactness and topology theorem. The maps, inverse maps, target actions, character constraints, two compact products and all forward/inverse estimates are proved directly. No new numerical calculation or finite classification is used.
notes: Both finite endpoint characters are retained on rank-one strips through their proved proportionality. The proof includes a simultaneous compact local pair-transport lemma for countably many actual transitive comparison spaces. Initial compact realization still uses the scalar-character comparison plane; the corresponding two-independent-character vertical-interval statement is not inferred. The constructed filling is in the explicitly named closed-subset homeomorphism group and only yields a filling of the full original relative loop when that subset is the whole disk.
